intro: The cryptocurrency and decentralized finance sectors faced a concentrated wave of attacks between April 12 and May 1, 2026, with 20 articles documenting 15 high-severity and 4 critical incidents. Threat actors Lazarus Group, BlueNoroff, and FakeWallet were observed targeting organizations globally, with significant impacts across the United States, Europe, North America, and Asia. The known vulnerability CVE-2023-4863 was involved in these campaigns, which primarily affected financial services and DeFi platforms.
